trigger: The prior 5 cm gate and E3E-R1 diagnostic showed B12/O13 worst-case candidate fluxes satisfying the split steady-Darcy path equation while the inherited steady_q oracle was numerically near the fully saturated Darcy upper bound.

scope.probe_set: reuse all 608 per-material E3E 5 cm probes for oracle characterization only

legacy_single_panel_t8.role: object under audit, not assumed authoritative in this new domain

split_adaptive.split: explicitly split at h=0; positive-head saturated segment evaluated analytically and negative-head segment by scipy quad
split_adaptive.root: brentq on physical q interval just above KSAT to saturated-Darcy upper bound

split_fixed_gl.equation: same path equation, explicit h=0 split
split_fixed_gl.unsaturated_quadrature: fixed 256-point Gauss-Legendre in h on the negative segment
split_fixed_gl.root: 80 fixed bisection iterations on the same physical q bracket

mpmath80_witness.witness_policy: freeze deterministic near-zero, moderate-negative, prior recorded worst-probe, and dry control before execution

legacy_oracle_characterization.no_legacy_oracle_acceptance_threshold: The gate decides validity from independent-oracle agreement; legacy discrepancy is evidence, not a tunable acceptance criterion.

hard_guards: No Ross candidate formula, node grid, quadrature policy or error tolerance is changed by this oracle gate.
The earlier 5 cm candidate FAIL remains preserved until a new independent qualification gate is executed against a qualified oracle.
The E3E-R1 reused probes are characterization data only and may not serve as the future candidate requalification holdout.
No surface-process, ponding, runoff, runtime or MultiSWAP admission follows from oracle qualification.
